name: @tinyhaptic/mascot
description: The Tiny Haptic mascot: a live Rive mascot with React and Astro components, its drawing and its icons.

scripts.build:
rm -rf dist && bun -e 'const { version } = await Bun.file("package.json").json(); await Bun.write("src/version.ts", `/** Written by the build from package.json. */
export const VERSION = "${version}";
`)' && tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun -e 'import { css } from "./dist/css.js"; await Bun.write("mascot.css", `/* Written by the build from src/css.ts. */
${css}`)' && chmod +x dist/cli.js
